name: study-flow-assistant
description: Pomodoro timer, lightweight task management, and daily planner for Obsidian.

scripts.deploy: node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const paths = ["../Obsidian Vault/.obsidian/plugins/study-flow-assistant", "../Obsidian Vault/System/.obsidian/plugins/study-flow-assistant"]; paths.forEach(p => { fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); ["main.js", "manifest.json", "styles.css"].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, p + "/" + f)); }); console.log("Deployed to all vaults!");'
